title: Market-tiered Vendor Onboarding: Audit Proxy + Insurance Co-op Pilot
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise procurement teams treat vendor onboarding as high-friction: long questionnaire cycles, repeated evidence requests, and ad-hoc insurance negotiations cause contract delays and higher operational cost for both Redwood and customers. Hypothesis: Offering tiered onboarding bundles that combine (1) an optional Audit Proxy service (centralized evidence collection and attestation), (2) a SOC2-lite package for SMBs, and (3) a co-op insurance purchasing option will reduce time-to-contract and increase conversion for mid-market customers while unlocking a new add-on revenue stream. Scope: Pilot a single-market experiment with 2 marketplace partners (one ISV, one platform integrator) to evaluate UX flow, legal requirements, pricing elasticity, and engineering effort for an Audit Proxy connector and vendor-portal UI. Out of scope: Full enterprise SOC2 audit services, on-prem audit collectors, and global insurance pooling (pilot will be US-only).
acceptance_criteria: A1: Design mockups for vendor portal flow (bundle selection, evidence upload, Audit Proxy enrollment) are reviewed and approved by Design and Legal
A2: Engineering implements an Audit Proxy MVP connector (SFTP + API ingestion) and a basic evidence tagging schema into the existing vendor portal
A3: Legal/Compliance signs off on the co-op insurance term sheet and a templated contract addendum
A4: Pilot pricing experiment configured in billing (one-time onboarding fee + optional monthly insurance credit subscription) with A/B cohorts
A5: Two marketplace partners onboarded into pilot with at least 3 vendors total agreeing to participate
success_metrics: Target: reduce average time-to-contract from procurement initiation to signed contract by 30% for pilot participants
Target: decrease manual evidence request volume per vendor by 50% via Audit Proxy or improved portal UX
Target: pilot conversion rate (vendor completes onboarding bundle) >= 25% for invited vendors
Revenue signal: initial ARR contribution from onboarding and insurance add-ons >= $60k (annualized) if pilot scales
work_items: PM: finalize pricing tiers, experiment matrix, and partner pitch deck
Design: vendor portal flows, enrollment microcopy, acceptance/decline UX for Audit Proxy
Engineering: spike for Audit Proxy connectors, vendor portal changes, billing flags for bundle SKUs
Legal: draft contract addendum and insurance co-op agreement; run privacy/data flow review
Sales/Partnerships: recruit two marketplace partners and coordinate pilot vendors
Ops: KYC/KYB checklist for vendors participating in insurance co-op
